rules.name: Get Stuck In
rules.effect: Friendly **ORKS** units' melee attacks have **[SUSTAINED HITS 1]**.

stratagems.name: Breakin' Heads
stratagems.timing: Any phase, when a friendly attached ORKS INFANTRY unit becomes battle-shocked.
stratagems.cond: That ORKS INFANTRY unit. You can target that unit with this stratagem even though it is battle-shocked.
stratagems.effect: Roll one D3: Your unit suffers a number of mortal wounds equal to the result.Your unit is no longer battle-shocked.
stratagems.summary: Suffer D3 mortal wounds; no longer Battle-shocked.

stratagems.name: Hit 'em Harder
stratagems.timing: Fight phase, when a friendly ORKS unit is selected to fight.
stratagems.effect: Your unit’s melee attacks have [Lethal Hits].

stratagems.name: Orks Is Never Beaten
stratagems.timing: Fight phase, when an enemy unit targets a friendly ORKS unit (excluding TITANIC units).
stratagems.effect: When a model in your unit is destroyed, if your unit has not been selected to fight this phase, roll one D6, with +1 to that roll if your unit is riled up: On a 4+, do not remove that model from the battlefield. When your unit has fought, or at the end of the phase (whichever comes first), that model is removed from the battlefield.
stratagems.summary: Destroyed models fight on 4+ (+1 if riled up).

stratagems.name: Mow 'em Down
stratagems.timing: Fight phase, when a friendly ORKS VEHICLE unit (excluding WALKER units) that made a charge move this turn is selected to fight.
stratagems.effect: Your unit’s melee attacks have: [Cleave 1].Or: If that attack already has [CLEAVE], +1 to the value of that [CLEAVE] (e.g. [CLEAVE 1] becomes [CLEAVE 2]).
stratagems.summary: Melee gains [CLEAVE 1], or +1 to existing [CLEAVE].

stratagems.name: Fungus-fuel Injection
stratagems.timing: Your Movement phase, when a friendly ORKS MOUNTED/VEHICLE unit is selected to move.
stratagems.effect: Your unit has +2" M.
stratagems.summary: +2" Movement.

stratagems.name: Close-range Dakka
stratagems.timing: Your Shooting phase, when a friendly ORKS unit is selected to shoot.
stratagems.effect: Your unit’s ranged attacks have: [Rapid Fire 1].Or: If that attack already has [RAPID FIRE], +1 to the value of that [RAPID FIRE] (e.g. [RAPID FIRE 1] becomes [RAPID FIRE 2]).
stratagems.summary: Ranged gains [RAPID FIRE 1], or +1 to existing [RAPID FIRE].

rules.name: Da Hunt Is On
rules.effect: Friendly **BEAST SNAGGA** units' attacks that targets a **MONSTER/VEHICLE** unit have +1 **AP**.

stratagems.name: Where D'ya Fink You're Going?
stratagems.timing: Your opponent’s Movement phase, when an enemy unit is selected to make a fall-back move, if that enemy unit is engaged with a friendly BEAST SNAGGA unit.
stratagems.effect: When an enemy unit engaged with your unit is selected to make a fall-back move, that enemy unit must use the desperate escape mode. If that enemy unit is a MONSTER/VEHICLE unit, that enemy unit makes three additional hazard rolls for each BEAST SNAGGA unit it is engaged with, with -1 from those hazard rolls if that enemy unit is battle-shocked.
stratagems.summary: Enemy must Desperate Escape; MONSTER/VEHICLE: +3 hazard rolls.

stratagems.name: Goaded Into Action
stratagems.timing: Your opponent’s Shooting phase, when an enemy unit has shot.
stratagems.cond: One friendly unengaged BEAST SNAGGA unit that lost a wound as a result of those attacks.
stratagems.effect: Your unit can make a surge move of up to D6". If your unit is riled up, it can re-roll that D6.
stratagems.summary: Surge move up to D6" (re-roll if riled up).

stratagems.name: Instinctive Hunters
stratagems.timing: End of your opponent’s Fight phase.
stratagems.cond: One friendly unengaged BEAST SNAGGA unit within 6" of a battlefield edge.
stratagems.effect: Place your unit in strategic reserves.
stratagems.summary: Place unit in strategic reserves.

rules.name: Try Dat Button!
rules.effect:
In your Shooting phase or the Fight phase, when a friendly **ORKS WALKER** unit (excluding **TITANIC** units) is **selected to attack**, you can use this ability. If you do, roll either one D6 or two D6 (keep re-rolling duplicate results). This unit's attacks have the relevant rule(s).

If you rolled two D6, when this unit has attacked, this unit makes one **hazard roll**.

stratagems.name: Crazed Rampage
stratagems.timing: Fight phase, when an enemy unit targets a friendly ORKS WALKER unit (excluding TITANIC units).

stratagems.name: Dread Power
stratagems.timing: Your Movement phase.
stratagems.effect: Your unit is riled up until the start of your next turn.
stratagems.summary: Unit is riled up until your next turn.

stratagems.name: Stomping Juggernaut
stratagems.timing: Your Movement/Charge phase, when a friendly ORKS WALKER unit is selected to move or declares a charge.
stratagems.effect: Your unit has MOBILE.
stratagems.summary: Unit gains MOBILE.

rules.name: Mob-handed Brutality
rules.effect:
- Friendly **BOYZ** units' melee attacks have **[SUSTAINED HITS 1]**.
- If a friendly **ORKS INFANTRY** unit made a **charge move** this turn, that unit's melee attacks have **[LETHAL HITS: non-MONSTER/VEHICLE]**.

stratagems.name: Unbridled Carnage
stratagems.timing: Fight phase, when a friendly BOYZ unit that made a charge move this turn is selected to fight.
stratagems.effect: Your unit’s melee attacks have +1 A.
stratagems.summary: Grant +1 A to unit's melee attacks.

stratagems.name: Mob Mentality
stratagems.timing: Start of the Battle-shock step of your Command phase.
stratagems.cond: One friendly ORKS INFANTRY unit of 13+ models.
stratagems.effect: Select one visible friendly ORKS unit within 12" of your unit. That unit’s battle-shock rolls are automatically successful.
stratagems.summary: ORKS unit within 12" auto-passes Battle-shock.

stratagems.name: 'ere We Go

stratagems.effect: Your unit has +2 to advance rolls.
stratagems.summary: +2 to Advance rolls.

rules.name: Displays of Savagery

stratagems.name: Hulking Brutes
stratagems.timing: Your opponent’s Shooting phase, when an enemy unit targets a friendly MEGANOBZ/NOBZ unit.
stratagems.effect: Ranged attacks that target your unit with a S greater than your unit’s T have -1 to wound rolls. +1CPOr: Ranged attacks that target your unit have -1 to wound rolls.

- When a friendly **SPEED FREEKS** unit is selected to make an **advance/fall-back move**:

stratagems.name: Delicious Eating Squigs

stratagems.summary: ORKS INFANTRY within 3" each heal 3 wounds.

stratagems.name: Dakkastorm
stratagems.timing: Your Shooting phase, when a friendly SPEED FREEKS unit is selected to shoot.
stratagems.effect: Your unit’s ranged attacks have [Sustained Hits 1].

stratagems.name: Speediest Freeks

stratagems.effect: Ranged attacks that target your unit fail on an unmodified hit roll of 1-3.
stratagems.summary: Incoming ranged attacks fail on unmodified hit rolls of 1-3.

rules.name: Suspiciously Well Organised
rules.effect:
Friendly **STORMBOYZ** units have **BATTLELINE**.
- When a friendly **BOYZ/KOMMANDOS/STORMBOYZ** unit is selected to make an **fall‑back move**, that **fall-back move** does not prevent that unit from being **eligible to declare a charge**.

stratagems.name: Dubious Restraint
stratagems.timing: Start/end of your Movement phase.
stratagems.effect: Select one objective your unit is controlling. That objective is secured.
stratagems.summary: Secure one controlled objective.

stratagems.name: Mind Mostly on the Mission
stratagems.timing: Your Movement phase, when a friendly BOYZ/KOMMANDOS/STORMBOYZ unit is selected to make an advance/fall-back move.
stratagems.effect: That move does not prevent your unit from being eligible to start an action.
stratagems.summary: Unit can move and still start an action.

stratagems.name: While Their Backs Are Turned
stratagems.timing: End of your opponent’s Movement phase.
stratagems.cond: One friendly unengaged BOYZ/KOMMANDOS/STORMBOYZ unit that was engaged at the start of the phase.
stratagems.effect: Your unit can make a normal move of up to 6".
stratagems.summary: Unit makes normal move up to 6".

rules.effect: Each time an attack targets an **^^Orks^^** unit from your army (excluding **^^Grots^^** units), if the Strength characteristic of that attack is greater than the Toughness characteristic of that **^^Orks^^** unit, subtract 1 from the Wound roll.

rules.name: Void Waaagh!
rules.effect:
Units from your army with the Waaagh! ability retain that ability and gain this one.

Once per battle, at the start of the battle round, you can call a Void Waaagh!. If you do, until the start of the next battle round, the Void Waaagh! is active for your army and:
- Add 1 to the Strength and Attacks characteristics of melee weapons equipped by models from your army with this ability.
- Models from your army with this ability have a 5+ invulnerable save.

A Void Waaagh! counts as a Waaagh! for any datasheet abilities.

stratagems.name: Pile Through
stratagems.timing: Your Movement phase, just after an ORKS unit from your army opens a Hatchway.
stratagems.effect: Until the end of the turn, your unit has the Fights First ability.
stratagems.summary: Grant Fights First to unit until end of turn.

stratagems.name: Ramboyz Rampage
stratagems.timing: Your Movement phase.
stratagems.cond: One BOYZ unit from your army that has not been selected to move this phase.
stratagems.effect: Until the end of the turn, your unit is eligible to declare a charge in a turn in which it Advanced and each time your unit Advances, do not make an Advance roll; instead, until the end of the phase, add 6" to the Move characteristic of models in your unit.
stratagems.summary: Charge after Advancing; Advance 6" instead of rolling.

stratagems.name: Eager to Fight
stratagems.timing: Your Movement phase, in the Reinforcements step, just after an ORKS unit from your army is set up in an Entry Zone.
stratagems.effect: Your unit can make an Advance move.
stratagems.summary: Unit makes an Advance move.

stratagems.name: Enraged Rush
stratagems.timing: Your opponent’s Shooting phase, just after an enemy unit has shot.
stratagems.cond: One BOYZ unit from your army that was selected as the target of one or more of the attacking unit’s attacks.
stratagems.effect: Your unit can make an Enraged Rush move. To do so, roll one D6: your unit can be moved a distance in inches up to the result, but must end that move as close as possible to the attacking unit. When doing so, those models can be moved within Engagement Range of that enemy unit, but only that enemy unit.
stratagems.summary: Move up to D6"; must move as close as possible to attacking unit; can move into Engagement Range with that unit only.

stratagems.summary: Hatchway stays open; -1 AP to incoming attacks until end of turn.

stratagems.name: Pit Fighter

stratagems.cond: One WARBOSS model from your army.
stratagems.effect: Until the end of the phase, your model is eligible to declare a charge in a turn in which it Fell Back.
stratagems.summary: Eligible to charge after Fall Back this turn.

stratagems.name: Cornered and Krumped
stratagems.timing: Your opponent’s Movement phase, just after an enemy unit is selected to Fall Back.
stratagems.cond: One ORKS unit from your army that is within Engagement Range of that enemy unit.
stratagems.effect: Your unit can fight as if it were the Fight phase, but when doing so, models in your unit can only target that enemy unit (and only if it is an eligible target) and each time a model in your unit makes an attack, an unmodified Hit roll of 6 is required to score a hit.
stratagems.summary: Fight outside Fight phase vs one unit; hits require unmodified 6s.

rules.name: Unstoppable Momentum
rules.effect:
- Friendly **WAGON** units can re-roll **charge rolls**.
- When a friendly **WAGON** unit is selected to make an **advance move**, that unit can change **advance rolls** to a 6.

stratagems.name: Keep It Runnin'
stratagems.timing: End of the Fight phase.
stratagems.cond: One friendly unengaged ORKS INFANTRY unit that was eligible to fight this phase and is wholly within 6" of a friendly TRANSPORT unit that INFANTRY unit is able to embark within.
stratagems.effect: Your INFANTRY unit embarks within that TRANSPORT unit.
stratagems.summary: INFANTRY unit embarks within the TRANSPORT.

stratagems.timing: Your Movement phase, when a friendly WAGON unit ends a normal move.
stratagems.effect: Units embarked within your unit can make an assault disembark move.
stratagems.summary: Embarked units can make an assault disembark move.

stratagems.timing: Your Charge phase, when a friendly WAGON unit ends a charge move.
stratagems.effect: Each enemy unit engaged with your unit makes a battle-shock roll, with -1 to that battle-shock roll.
stratagems.summary: Each enemy unit engaged with your unit makes a battle-shock roll at -1.

rules.name: Sneaky Little Gitz

- Friendly **GRETCHIN** units have **BATTLELINE**.

stratagems.cond: One friendly GRETCHIN unit that was just destroyed. You can target that unit with this stratagem even though that unit was just destroyed.
stratagems.effect: Add a new GRETCHIN unit to your army identical to your destroyed unit, in strategic reserves, at its starting strength, with its full wounds remaining.
stratagems.summary: Destroyed GRETCHIN unit returns at full strength in Strategic Reserves.

stratagems.timing: Your opponent’s Movement phase, when an enemy unit ends a move within 8" of a friendly unengaged GRETCHIN unit.
stratagems.effect: Your unit can make a normal move of: Up to D6".Or: Up to 6" instead if your unit is an attached unit.

stratagems.effect: When a hit roll for that enemy unit’s ranged attacks that target that ORKS unit results in a hit, if a model in your GRETCHIN unit is on the battlefield, end the attack sequence for that attack and your GRETCHIN unit suffers 1 mortal wound.

- While a friendly **ORKS AIRCRAFT/DEFFKOPTAS** unit is **riled up**, this unit's ranged attacks have +1 to **hit rolls**.

If this ability takes the form **Lone Operative X"**, unless part of an **attached** unit, this unit is not **visible** to enemy models unless they are within **X"** of this unit, and it cannot be targeted by **[INDIRECT FIRE]** weapons unless the attacking model is within **X"** of this unit.

glossary.name: Waaagh!
glossary.effect:
Friendly **ORKS** with this ability can:
- Re-roll **advance rolls**.
- Become **riled up**, as stated in other rules.
While a unit is **riled up**:
    - That unit has 5+ **InSv**.
    - That unit's ranged attacks have **[ASSAULT]**.
    - When that unit is selected to make an **advance move**, that **advance move** does not prevent that unit from being **eligible to declare a charge**.

glossary.name: Leader
glossary.effect: Before the battle, in the Muster Armies step, for each leader and support unit in your army, you can select one friendly bodyguard unit that unit can lead. That unit will then lead that bodyguard unit for the battle and form an attached unit with it. Unless otherwise stated, each bodyguard unit can only have one leader unit and one support unit attached to it.

glossary.name: Firing Deck
glossary.effect:
This ability always takes the form **Firing Deck X**. In your Shooting phase, each time this **TRANSPORT** is **selected to shoot**, if one or more units are embarked within it, resolve the following sequence: 
1. Select up to **X** models embarked within this **TRANSPORT** (excluding models whose units have already been **selected to shoot** this phase). 
2. For each selected model, select one of its ranged weapons (excluding **[ONE SHOT]** weapons). 
3. Until this **TRANSPORT** has resolved all of its attacks, it has all of those selected weapons in addition to its other weapons. 
4. Until the end of the turn, units embarked within this **TRANSPORT** are not eligible to shoot.

glossary.name: Damaged
glossary.effect:
This ability always takes the form **Damaged X**. While a model's remaining wounds are equal to or less than **X**, that model is **damaged**:
- While a model is **damaged**, that model's attacks have -1 to **hit rolls**.

glossary.name: Infiltrators
glossary.effect: During deployment, if every model in a unit has this ability, it can be set up anywhere on the battlefield that is more than 8" horizontally from your opponent’s deployment zone and all enemy units.

glossary.name: Stealth
glossary.effect: If every model in a unit has this ability, each time a ranged attack targets that unit, that unit has the **benefit of cover** against that attack (13.08).

glossary.name: Feel No Pain 6+
glossary.effect: This ability always takes the form **Feel No Pain X+**. Each time a model with this ability would lose a wound, roll one D6: on an **X+**, that wound is not lost.

glossary.name: Da Boss
glossary.effect: At the start of the battle round, if a model with this ability is your **WARLORD**, gain 1CP.

glossary.name: Super-Heavy Walker
glossary.effect:
Each time a unit with this ability makes a **normal**, **advance** or **fall-back move**: 
- Models in that unit can move through models (including **MONSTER/VEHICLE** models, but excluding **TITANIC** models) and can move horizontally through sections of **terrain features** that are 4" or less in height. 
- Before moving that unit, you can select for all models in that unit to have the **MOBILE** keyword until that move ends. If you do, when that move ends, roll one D6: on a 1, that unit is battle-shocked. 
***Designer’s Note:** Gaining the **MOBILE** keyword for the duration of a move will enable models in that unit to move horizontally through **dense terrain features** (13.06).*

glossary.name: Feel No Pain 5+
glossary.effect: This ability always takes the form **Feel No Pain X+**. Each time a model with this ability would lose a wound, roll one D6: on an **X+**, that wound is not lost.

glossary.name: Unstable Energies
glossary.effect:
**ORKS PSYKER** units with this ability have a **psyker level** of 1 or higher, specified in that unit's abilities. Each **psychic ability** has a **psychic level** of 1 or higher, specified in that ability's name.
In a battle round, a friendly **ORKS PSYKER** unit can use a number of **psychic abilities** whose total **psychic level** does not exceed that **PSYKER** unit's **psyker level**.

glossary.name: Support
glossary.effect:
Before the battle, in the Muster Armies step, for each **leader** and **support** unit in your army, you can select one friendly **bodyguard** unit that unit can lead. That unit will then lead that **bodyguard** unit for the battle and form an **attached** unit with it. 
Unless otherwise stated, each **bodyguard** unit can only have one **leader** unit and one **support** unit attached to it.

glossary.name: Lance
glossary.effect: Each time an attack is made with a **[LANCE]** weapon, if the attacking model’s unit made a **charge move** this turn, add 1 to the **wound roll**.

glossary.name: Blast
glossary.effect:
Each time you gather attack dice for a **[BLAST]** weapon, add one additional **attack dice** for every five models that were in the target unit in the Select Targets step (rounding down). If this ability takes the form **[BLAST X]**, each time you gather **attack dice** for such a weapon, add **X** additional **attack dice** for every five models that were in the target unit in the Select Targets step (rounding down) instead. 
***Example:** If a **[BLAST 2]** weapon with an **A** characteristic of 3 targets a unit containing 12 models, you would gather four additional **attack dice** for that weapon (for a total of seven for that weapon).*

glossary.name: Feel No Pain
glossary.effect: This ability always takes the form **Feel No Pain X+**. Each time a model with this ability would lose a wound, roll one D6: on an **X+**, that wound is not lost.

glossary.name: Scouts
glossary.effect:
This ability always takes the form **Scouts X"**. In the Resolve Pre-battle Abilities step, if every model in a unit has this ability, you can do one of the following: 
- If that unit is in **strategic reserves**, you can set up that unit anywhere that is wholly within your deployment zone. 
- If that unit is wholly within your deployment zone, it can make a **scout move**. 
- If that unit is embarked within a **DEDICATED TRANSPORT** that is wholly within your deployment zone, and if every model embarked within that **DEDICATED TRANSPORT** has the Scouts ability, that **DEDICATED TRANSPORT** can make a **scout move**.

glossary.name: Extra Attacks
glossary.effect:
Each time a unit containing one or more models with an **[EXTRA ATTACKS]** weapon fights, those models will make attacks with those weapons in addition to any others. In the Select Weapons step (04.01), for each of those models, you must select: 
- All of that model’s **[EXTRA ATTACKS]** weapons. 
- One of that model’s other melee weapons, if possible.

glossary.name: Pistol
glossary.effect:
**[PISTOL]** and **[CLOSE-QUARTERS]** are identical for all rules purposes. 

Units containing one or more models with a **[CLOSE-QUARTERS]** weapon can shoot using **close-quarters shooting** (10.06). When using another **shooting type**, for each model in that unit (excluding **MONSTER/VEHICLE** models), you can only select one of the following to make attacks with: 
- One or more of its **[CLOSE-QUARTERS]** weapons. 
- One or more of its other ranged weapons.

glossary.name: Crucible
glossary.effect: A **^^Character^^** created using Crucible rules has the Crucible ability. Your army may include up to three units with the Crucible ability and these units cannot be given Enhancements.

glossary.name: Anti
glossary.effect:
This ability always takes the form **[ANTI-X Y+]**. Each time an attack is made with an **[ANTI]** weapon, if the target unit has the keyword denoted by **X**, an unmodified **wound roll** of **Y+** is a **critical wound**.
***Example:** An attack made with an **[ANTI-VEHICLE 4+]** weapon against a ^^**Vehicle**^^ unit will result in a **critical wound** on an unmodified **wound roll** of 4+, while an attack made with an **[ANTI-PSYKER 2+]** weapon against a ^^**Psyker**^^ unit will result in a **critical wound** on an unmodified **wound roll** of 2+.*

glossary.name: Twin-linked
glossary.effect: Each time an attack is made with a **[TWIN-LINKED]** weapon, you can re-roll the **wound roll**.

glossary.name: Devastating Wounds
glossary.effect:
Each time an attack made with a **[DEVASTATING WOUNDS]** weapon results in a **critical wound**, the attack sequence for that attack ends and the target unit suffers a number of **mortal wounds** equal to the **D** characteristic of that weapon. These are inflicted after resolving any normal damage inflicted by those attacks. 
**Mortal wounds** inflicted by **[DEVASTATING WOUNDS]** weapons can damage a maximum of one model for each **critical wound**; any remaining **mortal wounds** inflicted by that attack are lost. 
***Example:** An attack made with a **[DEVASTATING WOUNDS]** weapon with a **D** characteristic of 3 results in a **critical wound** against an Intercessor Squad, so inflicts 3 **mortal wounds**. The first 2 **mortal wounds** are sufficient to **destroy** 1 Intercessor model, so the remaining **mortal wound** is lost.*

glossary.name: Hazardous
glossary.effect: Each time a unit is **selected to shoot** or **selected to fight**, after that unit has resolved all of its attacks, make a number of **hazard rolls** (06.03) for that unit equal to the number of **[HAZARDOUS]** weapons you selected in the Select Weapons step.
